title.narrative: Building Resilience with Active Countercyclical Expenditures Program

description.narrative: The principal objective of the Program is to mitigate the adverse socio-economic effects of the economic crises and enhance the resilience of poor and vulnerable groups to socio-economic shocks. The scope of the proposed program includes implementation of (a) increased social protection measures; (b) increased food security measures; and (c) enhanced support for business.

description.narrative:
Action 1: By June 2023, GOP to disburse PRs.2,000 per month to additional 6 million families having a monthly income of less than PRs40,000 per month, of which 20% are female-headed families (June 2022 baseline: no disbursement) Target date: 2023-12-31
Action 2: By June 2023, an additional 10,000 students will be provided BISP undergraduate scholarships (June 2022 baseline: no students) Target date: 2023-12-31

Action 4: By June 2023, Higher Education Commission issued 5,000 scholarships for Baluchistan and merged districts of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa of which 10% are female students. (June 2021 baseline: no scholarship) Target date: 2023-12-31
Action 5: By June 2023, GOP utilized PRs24 billion on health facilities (June 2022 baseline: no utilization) Target date: 2023-12-31
